column1: # Passphrase search coverage for the Corey Phillips kitten puzzle.

# my own results/PASSPHRASE_RUNS.md and results/STATUS.md (re-read and re-summed on
# witness: yes = a planted control passphrase in the same engine run was recovered
# independently reproduced by a second tool (btcrecover) on a subset.
author's own raw wordlists (skullsecurity lists bundled in the community repo)
Corey-specific corpus (108 mined words) raw plus 8 rule sets
Corey in-joke phrases (raw plus 2 rule sets)
two-word thematic combinator (35 words x 6 join styles)
human password lists (probable-v2 darkweb2017 xato-1M ncsc-100k raw and best64)
famous quotes plus BIP39 wordlist as a single-word passphrase
audio-puzzle decoded message and 32 minimal variants
alternate BIP84 index paths (0/1 1/0 1'/0/0 0/2) on the Corey corpus
independent cross-check with a second tool (btcrecover)
